name: Reverb Sculpting
description: Dramatically change the reverb character — size, decay time, wet/dry balance. Transform a dry, close sound into a vast, distant one (or vice versa).
usefulWhen: Changing the perceived space, shifting between intimate and vast, creating spatial drama
repair: Change reverb on at most 2 layers simultaneously. Changing reverb on all layers at once sounds like a production error rather than a creative choice.
strudelHints: Increase reverb on foreground elements, decrease on background for a spatial inversion

name: Space as Lead
description: Make the spatial/reverb tail the primary musical element. The direct sound becomes secondary — the space itself is what the listener follows.
usefulWhen: Creating an extreme spatial focus, making the room the main instrument
repair: Keep one element dry as a spatial reference point. Without a 'here', there is no 'there'.
strudelHints: .gain(0.05).room(0.95).delay(0.8) — the source is barely audible, the space is everything
Use very long reverb tails that overlap between events

name: Dry/Wet Morph
description: Gradually transition a sound from completely dry to completely wet (reverb only). The sound dissolves into the space.
usefulWhen: Fading a layer out in a creative way, transitioning between spatial states
repair: The transition should take at least 4 cycles. Instant wet/dry changes are jarring unless used as a deliberate effect.
strudelHints: Layer dry and wet versions, crossfading between them

name: Panorama Drift
description: Slowly move sounds across the stereo field over many cycles. A sound that slowly travels from left to right (or circles the listener) creates hypnotic spatial movement.
usefulWhen: Adding spatial movement to static elements, creating a sense of motion without rhythmic change
repair: Ensure mono compatibility — the sound should still be audible in mono. Extreme panning with phase effects can cancel completely in mono.
strudelHints: Layer a centered version at low gain for mono compatibility
Slow pan movement: one element drifting over 16+ cycles
